newsitem.title: CHINA: China state firms Jan-April losses up 2.1 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: China state firms Jan-April losses up 2.1 pct y/y.

text.p: Losses of China's state-owned firms covered under the central budget totalled 25.779 billion yuan ($3.105 billion) in January-April 1997, up 2.1 percent from the year-ago period, the Economic Daily said on Wednesday.

Post-tax profits of the state sector were 2.57 billion yuan ($309.6 million) in the first four months, down 32.9 percent from the year-ago period, the newspaper quoted figures from the State Statistical Bureau as showing.
Post-tax profits of the enterprises were 2.271 billion yuan in April alone while losses were 5.684 billion yuan, the figures showed but gave no comparative figures.
About 75 percent of China's more than 100,000 larger state firms are losing money as they struggle to adapt to nearly two decades of market-oriented economic reform.
